turns.user: Darren died in a car accident in Japan, what can I do?
turns.visible:
I’m very sorry for your loss. The Group Term Life summary says the Death Benefit is the Sum Assured shown in the certificate and says to notify Meridian Life Ltd of a death within 6 months, with the death certificate. The Personal Accident summary lists Accidental Death as 100% of the Sum Insured if death results from an Accident within 365 days, and says territorial limits are worldwide, 24 hours a day; it defines an Accident as a sudden, unforeseen and involuntary event caused by external, violent and visible means. The uploaded documents do not state the Personal Accident claim process or paperwork, and Meridian Life Ltd must confirm the applicable cover and requirements because the certificate figures are dated. Darren: PUBLIC SERVICE GROUP INSURANCE SCHEME (Meridian Life Ltd, a personal policy document); Public Service Group Term Life - Product Summary (Meridian Life Ltd, reference wording for the scheme, not a personal policy document); Public Service Group Personal Accident - Product Summary (Meridian Life Ltd, reference wording for the scheme, not a personal policy document). Michelle: PUBLIC SERVICE GROUP INSURANCE SCHEME (Meridian Life Ltd, a personal policy document); Public Service Group Term Life - Product Summary (Meridian Life Ltd, reference wording for the scheme, not a personal policy document); Public Service Group Personal Accident - Product Summary (Meridian Life Ltd, reference wording for the scheme, not a personal policy document); Public Service Group Insurance Scheme - Endorsement No. 3 (Meridian Life Ltd, linked, but not confirmed as a personal policy document). Not linked to anyone in the household: PawSafe Pet Insurance - Policy Wording (Lumen General); PawSafe Pet Insurance - Endorsement (Lumen General) -- link it to a person so it can be used for them.
On what date did the accident happen?

turns.user: The accident happened on 3 October 2026 and he died on 5 October 2026.
turns.visible:
I’m very sorry for your loss.
You told me, “The accident happened on 3 October 2026” and “he died on 5 October 2026.”
Darren’s certificate lists Group Term Life of S$1,000,000 and Group Personal Accident of S$600,000, each as of 6 October 2022; these are dated amounts, not confirmation of cover on the event date.
The Group Term Life Death Benefit is the Sum Assured shown in the Certificate of Group Insurance, and the summary says to notify Meridian Life Ltd of a death within 6 months with the death certificate.
The Personal Accident summary lists Accidental Death as 100% of the Sum Insured if death results from an Accident within 365 days; it defines an Accident as a sudden, unforeseen and involuntary event caused by external, violent and visible means, and says territorial limits are worldwide, 24 hours a day.
The Personal Accident calculator cannot determine an indicative amount because whether Darren’s death meets the policy’s definition must be confirmed through the insurer’s medical assessment; it identifies a specialist’s diagnosis report and the insurer’s claim form and medical assessment as relevant evidence.
To work out Darren’s accidental death under Public Service Group Personal Accident - Product Summary, I still need a reviewed decision that Darren’s diagnosis meets Public Service Group Personal Accident - Product Summary’s definition of death as a result of an Accident within 365 days of that Accident (the insurer’s medical assessment).

sentences.text: I’m very sorry for your loss.
You told me Darren died in a car accident in Japan.

Darren’s certificate lists Group Term Life sum assured of S$1,000,000 and Group Personal Accident sum assured of S$600,000, each as of 6 October 2022; these dated figures do not confirm cover on the date of death.
The Group Term Life summary says the Death Benefit is the Sum Assured shown in the certificate and says to notify Meridian Life Ltd of a death within 6 months, with the death certificate.

The Personal Accident summary lists Accidental Death as 100% of the Sum Insured if death results from an Accident within 365 days, and says territorial limits are worldwide, 24 hours a day; it defines an Accident as a sudden, unforeseen and involuntary event caused by external, violent and visible means.

The uploaded documents do not explain the claim paperwork or process for the Personal Accident benefit, and the certificate’s figures are dated, so Meridian Life Ltd will need to confirm the applicable cover and claim requirements.

next_steps: Contact Meridian Life Ltd promptly to notify them of the death and ask how to submit claims under both benefits; the term-life summary specifies notification within 6 months.
Keep the death certificate and any Japanese police, accident, medical, and transport records, and ask the insurer which translations or certified copies it requires.
